title: The Pile: An 800GB Dataset of Diverse Text
authors: L. Gao, S. Biderman, S. Black, et al. (12 authors)
before: Frontier training data was proprietary and undocumented.
problem: Outsiders could not reproduce large-model training without a comparable corpus.
breakthrough: 825 GiB assembled from 22 documented sources, released openly.
why: It let independent groups train serious models, which is how the open ecosystem started.
next: Pythia, GPT-NeoX and OPT trained on it; later corpora refined its mix.
inherits: Open, documented pretraining data as a community resource.
